title: FCS Control
description: A single project-local control in the Fintech Compliance Skills catalog. FCS ids are LOCAL project identifiers, not official regulation article numbers.

id.description: Permanent project-local control id. Never reused once retired.

statement.description: What the control requires, in one or two sentences.

control_type.description: The engineering nature of the control.

source_refs.description: One or more distinct bases. A control may carry several (law + standard + project policy).

source_version.description: Version/edition of the primary source if known (e.g. 'PCI DSS v4.0.1'). Null when unverified.

effective_date.description: ISO date the source became effective, if known. Null when unknown.

reviewed_at.description: ISO date this control's source claim was last human-reviewed. Null = never.

review_status.description: verified = article+scope confirmed against an official source; needs_review = source reachable but claim not yet confirmed; unverified = not checked.

owner_role.description: The role accountable for this control (e.g. 'engineering', 'compliance', 'security').

skill_refs.description: Repo-relative skill files that teach/enforce this control.

test_refs.description: Repo-relative tests/harness scenarios that exercise this control.

limitations.description: Known gaps: what this control does NOT guarantee, and where the claim is weaker than it looks.

replaces.description: If this control supersedes a retired id, the retired id. Retired ids are never reused for a new meaning.

kind.description: Separates legal obligation, industry standard, project's own stricter policy, and engineering advice.

label.description: Human label, e.g. 'PCI DSS Req 3.3.1' or 'KVKK Art. 7'.

url.description: Link to the source. Reachability is NOT the same as the claim being verified.

verified.description: True only when the article number AND its scope were confirmed against the official text.
